title: "[VHH]-Cluster-Cleaning"

This workflow is based on `antigen-selected` databases (Ex: `S19`, `S20`, `S21`). To select the best members of each `antigen-selected` cluster, we need to find and draw information from the clonal family members in the `source databases` (library or cDNA). 

It is the distinctions between `antigen-selected` members and `source members` of each clonal family that is critical.

We cannot expect the highly-enriched and selected VHHs in the antigen-selected databases to always have closely related CDR3 regions, thus we need a new method to identify clonal families in the source databases.

## Proposed method
 
1. Hierarchical clustering of VHHs in each of the antigen-selected databases

2. Define the `antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3` for each cluster in **(1)**

3. Combine clearly related clusters in **(2)** using unambiguously related `CDR consensus sequences`, these are now our `antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3 clusters`.

  -	We need to establish safe criteria for `unambiguously related` to safely pool clusters, for example:

    *	10 aa CDR3, >60% homology within databases selected on the same target?
  
    *	6-9 aa CDR3, >80% homology within databases selected on the same target? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?)
  
    *	<6 aa CDR3, 100% homology? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?) 
  
  -	Determine the number of members of each clonal family within each antigen-selected clonal family
  
    *	This number will be critical to identifying clonal families that became ‘significantly’ reduced through competition during the panning process

    *	We may need replicate databases to establish the significance of the clonal family numbers

    *	Add a curation step to remove outlier non-family members based on lower homology?

4.	Recluster outliers and include new unambiguous clusters in ‘antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3 clusters’

5.	Select all unambiguous antigen-selected clonal families from step 3 with a critical mass of unique members

    * This number may be all >5 or >10 unique VHHs, or top 100 unique VHHs, or something TBD

5.	Identify the most abundant full VHH amino acid sequence in each unambiguous clusters in step 4 as the ‘best representative’ of each cluster

6.	Identify the ‘closest source homologue’ (overall VHH amino acid sequence homology (not CDR3)) to each of ‘best representative’ VHH for each cluster in step 5

    *	Sources may be either (or both) VHH-display library or the alpaca cDNA 

7.	Cluster each ‘closest source homologue’ from step 6 within its source library and establish the ‘source consensus CDR3 cluster’ for each ‘antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3 cluster’

8.	Determine the numbers of VHH members of each ‘source consensus CDR3 cluster’ from step 7 within each available source database

9.	Align unique VHHs found in each ‘source consensus CDR3 cluster’, compared to the most abundant VHHs in the ‘antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3 cluster’

  -	Ultimately, we will want an algorithm to select the ‘most promising’ VHH member of each ‘antigen-selected VHH consensus CDR3 cluster’
  -	For now, we will have do this manually as we work out the best rules

## Load Antigen-Selected Databases (S19 for now)

We will expand shortly to combine `{S19, S20, S21}` for re-cleaning (as they will have many duplicates and many of the same poorly-formed clusters).

### Load consensus database

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
cdb <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/cluster_database/9_L3_sh2_S9_min_threshold_clone-pass-consensuses15Mar24.csv", 
                header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Subset only 19 for now
cdb <- cdb[cdb$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]

# Order by Dup_count
cdb <- cdb[order(cdb$Dup_count, decreasing = T),]

print(head(cdb))
```


Unsurprisingly, these larger clusters are our "usual suspects!"


### Load individual clonal database

```{r, warning = F, eval = T, echo = F}
db <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

db$f <- rep("19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", each = nrow(db))

# Trim CDR3s
db$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(db$junction_aa)

# Translate
db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)

# Trim
db$VHH <- substr(db$VHH, 11, nchar(db$VHH))

# Keep productive only
nrow(db)
db <- unproductive(db)
nrow(db)
```

## Initial logo-plots

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
for (nm in head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
  tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  common_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
      print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
      cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```

## Cleaning Implementation

### Initial Dataset Construction

**We want:**

1. `CDR3-entropy`

2. `VHH-entropy`

3. `median-CDR3` (`CDR3-consensus`?)

4. `median-VHH` (`VHH-consensus`?)


```{r, eval = T, echo = T}
results <- data.frame()

for (nm in head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
  tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  common_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  ## Subset variables of interest
  
  tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(common_VHH, tmp_frame$VHH))/nchar(common_VHH))*100
  
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3_distance <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(common_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(common_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3 <- rep(common_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$median_VHH <- rep(common_VHH, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3 <- rep(consensus_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$CDR3_entropy <- rep(CDR3_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$VHH_entropy <- rep(VHH_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}

rm(tmp_frame, unrolled_CDR3s, unrolled_VHHs)
```

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}

                      "sequence_id",

```

## Rule-based Cleaning Logoplots


*	10 aa CDR3, >60% homology within databases selected on the same target?
  
*	6-9 aa CDR3, >80% homology within databases selected on the same target? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?)
  
*	<6 aa CDR3, 100% homology? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?) 
  

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
for (nm in head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
  # Subset from results
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  # Pull values for constraints
  consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
  median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
  
  ## Enforce Constraints
  if (nchar(consensus_CDR3) >= 10){
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance >= 60,]
  } else if ((nchar(common_CDR3) > 6) & (nchar(consensus_CDR3) < 10)){
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance >= 80,]
  } else {
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance == 100 & 
                             tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance >= 90,]
  }
  
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  common_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)

  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
      print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
      cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```

## "Clean" Logoplots

Arbitrarily, let's try the rule where **we drop clones from a group if**:

1. The `median_VHH_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

2. The `median_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

3. The `consensus_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.`

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
for (nm in head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
  # Subset from results
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  # Find thresholds
  vhh_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance)[["1st Qu."]]
  cdr3_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_CDR3_distance)[["1st Qu."]]
  cons_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance)[["1st Qu."]]

  # Enforce constraints
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance >= vhh_dist_thresh & 
                         tmp_frame$median_CDR3_distance >= cdr3_dist_thresh &
                         tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance >= cons_dist_thresh,]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  common_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
      print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
      cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```

## "Cleaner" (no singleton) Logoplots

Arbitrarily, let's try the rule where **we drop clones from a group if**:

1. The `median_VHH_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

2. The `median_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

3. The `consensus_CDR3_distance` is below the `1st Qu.` **AND**

4. Must have >= 2 copies (that is, it must _not_ be a singleton)

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
for (nm in head(cdb$cluster_id, 5)){
  # Subset from results
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$duplicate_count >= 2,]
  
  # Find thresholds
  vhh_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance)[["1st Qu."]]
  cdr3_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$median_CDR3_distance)[["1st Qu."]]
  cons_dist_thresh <- summary(tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance)[["1st Qu."]]

  # Enforce constraints
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$median_VHH_distance >= vhh_dist_thresh & 
                         tmp_frame$median_CDR3_distance >= cdr3_dist_thresh &
                         tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_distance >= cons_dist_thresh,]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  common_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat("Group ID: ", paste('S',unique(substr(tmp_frame$f, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(tmp_frame), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most represented VHHs:\n")
      print(head(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)]))
      cat("CDR3 Entropy: ", CDR3_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("VHH Entropy: ", VHH_entropy, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```
